title_sq: Apartament dublex 3+1 me verande dhe 1 dhome bodrum ne shitje ne rrugen Jordan Misja ne afersi te Gjykates se Krimeve te Renda ne Tirane (ID 4139139)
description_sq:
Ne rrugen Jordan Misja ne afersi te Gjykates se Krimeve te Renda, shitet apartament dubleks 3+1 me verande dhe 1 dhome bodrum, siperfaqe totale 126.6 m² me certifikate pronesie, 20 m² verande(e pa legalizuar), kati perdhe ne nje pallat ekzistues me tulle te kuqe.
Apartamenti organizohet ne:
kati perdhe: nje dhome ndenje, dhome gatimi, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete, koridor shperndares, verande

Hapesira e madhe dhe hyrje/dalje edhe nga ana e verandes, i jep mundesi ketij apartamenti te ndahet ne 2 apartamente, secili me hyrje me vete.
Cmimi 200000 euro.
title_en: Duplex apartment 3+1 with veranda and 1 basement room for sale on Jordan Misja Street near the Serious Crimes Court in Tirana (ID 4139139)
description_en: On Jordan Misja street near the Court of Serious Crimes, duplex apartment 3+1 with veranda and 1 basement room for sale, total area 126.6 m² with ownership certificate, 20 m² veranda (not legalized), ground floor in an existing red brick building. The apartment is organized in: ground floor: a living room, kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, distribution corridor, veranda, 1st floor: basement. The large space and entrance/exit also from the side of the veranda, allows this apartment to be divided into 2 apartments, each with its own entrance. The price is 200,000 euros.
